limitations: No vendor datasheet, device model or toolchain was consulted for either side; nothing in this catalogue is a vendor statement.
The target is a capability profile, not a device: it has no resource counts, no speed grade and no I/O bank rules, so resource fit and timing cannot be assessed against it at all.

The negative-edge flip-flop family (SB_DFFN, SB_DFFNE, SB_DFFNR, SB_DFFNS, SB_DFFNSR, SB_DFFNSS, SB_DFFNER, SB_DFFNES, SB_DFFNESR, SB_DFFNESS) is deliberately NOT covered in this revision: falling-edge capture interacts with the target's clocking rules and was not reviewed. Designs using it are reported as unresolved, which is the intended outcome, not an oversight.
SB_LFOSC, SB_HFOSC, SB_I2C and SB_SPI are hard IP with no generic equivalent and are unresolved by construction.
